name: Dávod (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Dávod: a quartered shield of red and blue with a mitre, a bishop's crozier, a harp and a lion, with a scroll inscribed DÁVOD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Dávod arms with mitre and scroll
